output.title: When the call summary appears in the member portal
output.draft_text:
Question: When will the call summary show in the member portal?

Answer: A summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two business days. Tell the member this in your own words, for example: "You'll be able to see a summary of today's call in your member portal within two business days."

Where to find it: The summary is located in [portal section or menu path where call summaries appear].

If the summary has not appeared after two business days: [next step for the member or advocate, such as who to contact or how to request the summary].
